item.text: I’ll first check the current folder so the app fits the existing workspace, then I’ll build the four linked pages with accessible navigation, course search and filters, registration, and confirmation.

The folder is empty, so I’m creating a small static site from scratch. I’ll use four HTML pages with shared styling and JavaScript, and store registrations in the browser so the demo works without a backend.

p=Path('registration.html')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('id=\"student-name\" name=\"studentName\" autocomplete=\"name\" required', 'id=\"student-name\" name=\"studentName\" autocomplete=\"name\" aria-describedby=\"student-name-error\" required')
s=s.replace('id=\"student-email\" name=\"studentEmail\" type=\"email\" autocomplete=\"email\" required', 'id=\"student-email\" name=\"studentEmail\" type=\"email\" autocomplete=\"email\" aria-describedby=\"student-email-error\" required')
s=s.replace('id=\"student-id\" name=\"studentId\" required', 'id=\"student-id\" name=\"studentId\" aria-describedby=\"student-id-error\" required')
s=s.replace('class=\"field-error\" id=\"student-name-error\"', 'class=\"field-error\" id=\"student-name-error\" aria-live=\"polite\"')
s=s.replace('class=\"field-error\" id=\"student-email-error\"', 'class=\"field-error\" id=\"student-email-error\" aria-live=\"polite\"')
s=s.replace('class=\"field-error\" id=\"student-id-error\"', 'class=\"field-error\" id=\"student-id-error\" aria-live=\"polite\"')
p.write_text(s)
PY
node --check app.js && git status --short"

item.text:
Created the four-page responsive course registration app. The navigation links Home, Course Catalog, Registration, and Student Profile; registration data persists in the browser’s local storage.

The catalog includes 16 sample courses with search and filters. Registration includes form validation, an 18-credit limit, a live course summary, and an accessible confirmation modal. The profile shows registered courses in a table.

JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check app.js`. I wasn’t able to verify the pages in a browser.
